title: Meaheim
author: Tsurubuchi Kenji
description:
Rotten fruit returns to the branch, and gold drips down like water, A land where events beyond reason occur, a land known as Meichi (Underworld) that easily claims the lives of those who dare to enter. The scholar Ren arrives in this godforsaken land to save his sick younger brother. Together with the guide Tobia, Ren embarks on a perilous journey to obtain the Panacea, an ancient relic of Meichi.

Tags: Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery
